spec.description: The job runs python3 examples/tools/build.py 307 --task mutant-replay, the target route of llm-dlc/loops/example-targets.md, on the source-slice route the user chose for P3 (example 307, Spring Security fe9e4549, BCrypt.hashpw with StandardCharsets.UTF_8) on 2026-11-15, since the commits' own Gradle builds can't resolve their buildscript from the allowed hosts. Each commit is fetched from github.com at depth 1 or 2 and only crypto/.../bcrypt/BCrypt.java is compiled, by Temurin 8's javac with -g -source 1.8 -target 1.8 -encoding UTF-8; BCrypt needs only the JDK, so the slice has no dependency JARs. New in this job: before's preparation fetches Spring Security 5.2.0.M4's published spring-security-crypto JAR from repo.spring.io/milestone by its sha256 (8871c1fe...) and compares its BCrypt.class (sha256 0b137406...) with the slice's byte for byte (target.json preparation.slice.matches, runtime._match_published); a difference fails the preparation as a blocker, never a slice used anyway. A hand compile on 2026-11-14 (a note) gave identical bytes. The driver (HashpwDriver: 45 probes, three fixed salts from upstream's BCryptTests and four invalid ones, passwords from empty to 73 UTF-8 bytes, surrogates and null) runs in a separate JVM per revision on JDK 21 and on JDK 25, and workflow ingests the records into one format-2 receipt, read by the packet's independent oracle (controls/oracle.py problems(), which encodes UTF-8 itself and has no cipher), labelled extracted-source-slice in claim.target.scopes. A replay decides no claim: build.py exits 0 only when the receipt's matchesExpected is true. This task: the mutation pair, after (fe9e4549) against the constructed mutant (controls/us-ascii.patch, sha256 a2b4e97f..., applied to after's BCrypt.java and compiled by the same recipe: the password is encoded with US-ASCII, so every non-ASCII character becomes '?'). Its identity is mutant:fe9e4549+a2b4e97f; it is sensitivity evidence, never a historical result. After must hold the oracle on every probe and the mutant must fail it at the non-ASCII probes only.
spec.expected: build.py prints '307-...: task mutant-replay: none (completed; as expected)' and exits 0: after holds the oracle on JDK 21 and 25, and the mutant fails it at non-ASCII password probes and no ASCII one; a receipt under examples/307-*/receipts/mutant-replay/ whose claim.target.scopes says extracted-source-slice for after and constructed-mutation-of-a-slice for the mutant
